tw: "What do you think?" Kron asks a pink skunk, who winks and drinks his ink.
twc: Kron 问粉色臭鼬“你觉得呢？”，臭鼬眨眨眼喝光了他的墨水。

tw: On summer holiday, Kron's summer lolly drips, and a jolly collie licks it all day.
twc: 暑假里 Kron 的冰棍一直滴，一只快乐的牧羊犬舔了一整天。
hint: 暑假冰棍，狗比人吃得多。

tw: Kron must go back to the black shack, where a yak goes "Quack!"
twc: Kron 得回那间黑棚屋去，屋里一头牦牛在“嘎嘎”叫。
hint: 回到老地方，牦牛变鸭子。

tw: How long can Kron hold the long song before the brown cow howls along?
twc: Kron 这首长歌能唱多久？直到棕色奶牛跟着嚎起来。

tw: At Ocean Park, a shark in the dark barks, and Kron slowly rows his show boat.
twc: 在海洋公园，黑暗里一条鲨鱼汪汪叫，Kron 慢慢划着表演船。
hint: 海洋公园的鲨鱼会狗叫。

tw: In Taipei, Kron ties a pie to his tie, and a pigeon pays a penny.
twc: 在台北，Kron 把馅饼拴在领带上，一只鸽子付了一分钱。

tw: Kron will travel around the world in a curled-up gravel bowl, round and round.
twc: Kron 要坐一只卷边的碎石碗环游世界，转呀转呀转。

tw: Football player Kron puts his foot on the ball, but a tall bull plays it away.
twc: 足球运动员 Kron 一脚踩住球，一头高个公牛却把球带走了。

tw: At the World Cup, Kron's pup curls up in the big gold cup.
twc: 在世界杯上，Kron 的小狗蜷在大金杯里睡着了。

tw: Kron's crow likes to go by Bo, and Bo says bye to every boat.
twc: Kron 的乌鸦喜欢被叫作“波”，波跟每条船都说拜拜。

tw: Kron's pool will be full of wool once the bull pulls in ten sheep.
twc: 公牛拉进来十只羊，Kron 的泳池就满是羊毛了。

tw: Kron must be ready to do two steady spins on Teddy's red rope.
twc: Kron 得准备好在泰迪的红绳上稳稳转两圈。

tw: "Good luck!" says Kron to a duck stuck in a wooden truck full of muck.
twc: Kron 对一只卡在满是泥巴的木头卡车里的鸭子说：“祝你好运！”

tw: At the weekend, a sneaky beak pecks Kron's leek at both ends.
twc: 周末，一只鬼鬼祟祟的鸟嘴把 Kron 的大葱两头都啄了。
hint: 周末种的葱，两头都没了。

tw: Kron tries to make friends with ten French hens who bake cake.
twc: Kron 想和十只会烤蛋糕的法国母鸡交朋友。

tw: "Take it apart?" Kron asks, then takes a large tart apart, part by part.
twc: “把它拆开？”Kron 问完，就把大果挞一块一块拆开了。

tw: At six p.m., Kron feeds peas to a pea-green emu named Em.
twc: 下午六点，Kron 给一只叫阿 M 的豌豆绿鸸鹋喂豌豆。

tw: Kron would like a wooden bike, but a good wolf likes it too and rides off.
twc: Kron 想要一辆木头自行车，可一只好心的狼也喜欢，骑走了。

tw: Kron notices a bored goat nibbling notes off the noticeboard.
twc: Kron 发现一只无聊的山羊在啃布告板上的通知。

tw: At eight a.m., Kron wakes up, and eight hens play a drum on his bed.
twc: 早上八点 Kron 一醒，八只母鸡在他床上打鼓。
